# ADIP LA — Another Day in Paradise (recreation)
A complete recreation of anotherdayinparadise.la — every page, every image, every function — in a new design. Hand-drawn meditation art by Farhad Rabbany, Beverly Hills 90210: hoodies $175, caps $69, tee $75, the hand-drawn Artist-Designed Cap $300 ($100 deposit), canvas prints in five sizes ($200-$350). One print, Flow of Serenity, is price-on-request (listed at $0 in the catalogue). US shipping $12 flat, free at $200. One returns rule: 14 days. Studio: 1031 S Wooster Street, Los Angeles 90035, Mon-Fri 10:00-16:00. Contact: info@anotherdayinparadise.la. Social: Instagram/Threads @a.d.i.p.la, Facebook AnotherDayInParadiseADIP. Not food: a London chef uses a similar name; this is hand-drawn art.
Pages: index, shop, product (every product, full photo gallery), gallery (every drawing, lightbox), about, faq, contact, cart, checkout, account, commission, shipping, returns, terms, privacy, cookies, accessibility.
